findings.summary: The change (commit f31c4aa5) adds a memory-only player shell (`player-shell.mjs`), a new ending fixture and the opening/ending/replay UI in `LoopPlayer.tsx`. It meets all three CODEX-06-C acceptance criteria. The recap shows only the actual guess, position and result of each try, with text that varies for zero, one or several tries, and claims no mastery or aha. The ending can come before any Test or with untested choices, and resume returns to the same play. The new-wonder handoff truthfully says intake is unavailable, nothing was submitted and a child must be explicitly confirmed. Replay asks for new IDs for each path and keeps the old engines. If an ID request fails or returns a duplicate, nothing changes. The controller's evidence was run on this exact revision: npm test passed 35/35, the build passed, the pinned card checker passed (old and new probes, 44 routes, seeded secret scan), and a native browser check at 320px phone and desktop sizes passed. That browser check included keyboard use, muted audio staying muted on resume with no autoplay, and moving both ways between the original play and the replay. That fixes the problem the earlier 4bf9780 browser check found. A React test now covers moving both ways between plays. The remaining open decisions (WM-07 saving and dedupe, WM-09 feedback and intake, privacy, voice and content review, release) stay open and are labelled honestly.

findings.title: ENDING_CONTRACT still says UI only offers earlier groups
findings.problem: The Intents section still says 'UI earlier-play buttons offer only groups preceding the current group.' That was the behaviour the controller's browser check rejected. The correction paragraph at the end of the file contradicts it. ending_instructions.txt line 8 has the same older 'only retained earlier groups' wording. The controller's correction finding replaced it, but the contract doc this task owns should state the current behaviour without contradicting itself.
findings.fix_check: In the Intents section, say that the parent controls list every other kept group (earlier and newer) with fixed original group numbers. No sentence should still limit the buttons to earlier groups.

findings.title: Two h1 headings render while playing
findings.problem: The shell's h1 ('Investigate your idea') and PlayerSession's h1 ('Pretend balance') appear together in the playing view. Keyboard use and the visible focus outline passed the browser check, but two top-level headings make the outline less clear for screen-reader users.
findings.fix_check: When PlayerSession runs inside the shell (onFinish is provided), render its title as h2, and check the heading structure in the browser accessibility tree.

findings.title: REPORT body still lists checks as not run
findings.problem: The verification table still says each check is 'Not run'. Only the appended correction line mentions the later checks. The controller's own record holds the actual passing evidence, but anyone reading the report alone could misread the task's status.
findings.fix_check: Have the controller-owned record or a note in the report point to the exact passing results for test, build, checker and the browser check at f31c4aa.
